title: Event Envelope
description: Standard envelope for all domain events in the Stock Trading Platform

eventVersion.description: Schema version for this event type

occurredAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the event occurred

aggregateId.description: ID of the aggregate that produced this event (e.g., orderId, userId)

correlationId.description: Correlation ID linking all events in a single business flow

causationId.description: ID of the event or command that caused this event
